race.comment: HAWKER HALL (5) defied a betting drift first-up after he showed good early toe to grip on and win in a tight finish over 1100m at Randwick. Has a ton of upside and gets his change again from the low gate with J Mac retaining the ride. ISTOLEA MERC (8) was a month between runs and unwanted in betting before warming up late to run second to HAWKER HALL over 1100m at Randwick. Well weighted today and capable of turning the tables. TORQUE TO BE SURE (6) strips fitter now and gets a better set-up after failing to get on the track first-up. Drops in weight and stays in the calculations from a better gate. EAGLE EXPRESS (10) good fresh mare who looks well placed on the limit weight. Fitted with the two trials and the booking of Zac Lloyd from the inside gate is a good lead to her chances. GRAND IMPACT (3) sprinted well first-up when second to Roselyn's Star in the July Sprint over the 1100m here. A repeat showing can see him take a hand in the finish.
